about.title: Senior Node.js Developer & Solution Architect — Practical, Curious, Hands-On
about.biography: I come from a Bengali Indian family in Midnapore, West Bengal. I completed my B.Sc. in Computer Science in 2016 from Midnapore College and M.Sc. in Computer Science in 2018 from Vidyasagar University. As a student I was never the front-bench superstar; I was the persistent questioner — always asking why and how — which shaped my deep problem-solving mindset and architectural curiosity.
about.careerJourney: I started professionally as a Software Test Engineer at Infoaxon, which instilled in me a deep appreciation for software quality, defensive programming, and rigorous testing across enterprise portals like Hyundai and Maruti Suzuki. I subsequently transitioned into full development and found my true calling in backend systems engineering. Since 2019, I have specialized in Node.js, building enterprise REST and GraphQL services, upgrading legacy architectures to modern LTS standards, and operating my own home server lab to prototype distributed infrastructure ideas.
about.philosophy: I care deeply about clean, secure, and maintainable code. I enjoy tackling performance bottlenecks, reliability glitches, and complex integrations. I take immense pride in shipping systems that business stakeholders and end-users can rely on 24/7 without surprises.
about.personalInterests: Outside of engineering, I recharge by riding my motorcycle on weekends, exploring cutting-edge developer tools, and experimenting with my home server cluster — whether spinning up isolated Linux VMs, testing automated CI/CD pipelines, or running lightweight database replicas for benchmark testing.
about.whoIAmToday: Today, I consider myself a pragmatic computer programmer and solution architect who prioritizes clarity, performance, and real business outcomes over hype. I enjoy mentoring team members, collaborating with engineering leadership, and contributing to open-source software.
